turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale, I've got about twenty minutes. Who decided on the zero, and was anyone going to call me before Owen saw it on his phone in the middle of class?
I'm waiting, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and what do you have?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Save it, Hale. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered. Did you call me?
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
I don't give blessings, Hale. I read documents. What is "your way", and does it start with the zero coming off?
